card_text: Repairs ABS pumps and control modules at a Kaki Bukit workshop.
Also Mercedes gearbox control units, steering locks and hybrid batteries.
lede: The ECU Clinic repairs car electronics at Premier @ Kaki Bukit. When an ABS or brake warning light will not clear, the unit is tested and repaired on the bench where possible instead of simply replaced. WhatsApp the car model, chassis number and fault code to 9893 1923, or call.

services.d: ABS, ESP and ESC units repaired, or a reconditioned or used unit supplied when that is the better route.
Gearbox warnings, harsh shifts or a gear that sticks: the transmission control unit is diagnosed and repaired.
For a key that will not turn or a car that will not start because of the electronic steering lock.
A brand-new OEM hybrid battery, with a warranty of 1 year or 100,000 km.

price_note: Prices are not listed. Send the fault code and car details by WhatsApp to get the options and a price.

faqs: Can you repair my ABS pump or module?
Yes. ABS, ESP and ESC modules are repaired, and used or reconditioned pumps are supplied for makes such as Toyota, Honda, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Kia, Volkswagen and Audi.
What should I send on WhatsApp?
The car model, chassis number and fault code. A photo of the scan tool screen or the dashboard warning helps.
Repairs carry a 6-month warranty. New hybrid batteries carry 1 year or 100,000 km.
Pick-up and delivery are available, and after-hours appointments can be arranged.
